zh: n 个有编号的顶点之间共有 n(n−1)/2 个不同的顶点对，每一对都可以独立地选择连边或不连边。
不同的选择方式与不同的图一一对应，由乘法原理答案是 2^(n(n−1)/2)。
n 可达 10⁹，指数 n(n−1)/2 约 5×10¹⁷，仍在 64 位范围内；用快速幂计算 2 的这个次方对 1000000007 取模，每次乘法后取模。
en: Among n labelled vertices there are n(n−1)/2 distinct vertex pairs, and each pair independently has an edge or not.
Different choices correspond one to one to different graphs, so by the multiplication principle the answer is 2^(n(n−1)/2).
n can be 10^9, so the exponent n(n−1)/2 is about 5×10^17, still within 64 bits; compute 2 to that power modulo 1000000007 with fast exponentiation, reducing after every multiplication.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Each distinct vertex pair corresponds to one independent optional edge; compute 2 to the power n(n−1)/2 with fast exponentiation.

## Proof of correctness

There are n(n−1)/2 vertex pairs, and each pair either has an edge or not; all choices correspond one to one to graphs, and the multiplication principle gives the result.

## Complexity

O(log n) time, O(1) extra space.
